num_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the graph.
num_edges: <int> Total number of edges in the graph.
interdiction_budget_k: <int> Maximum number of edges the interdictor is allowed to remove from the graph.
vertices: <list[int], length num_vertices> Labels identifying each vertex in the graph.
edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Pairs of vertices connected by an edge in the graph.
